rulesVersion1.policy: measured in G1; the official emulator loads v1 sources and denies list with the warning "Permission denied. List operations are only allowed for rules_version='2'."; Firenook accepts v1 sources for firebase.storage only if G1 shows the emulator accepting them, and then reproduces the list denial; otherwise v1 sources are rejected with a diagnostic naming the line
rulesVersion1.settled: emulator loads v1 sources, admits get/create and denies list with the warning; Firenook accepts v1 for firebase.storage and reproduces the list denial (emulator-programs.json method-rules-version-1)

uidDerivation.policy: measured in G1; the official emulator derives request.auth.uid from the user_id claim only (uid is null when only sub is present); the current Firenook jar bridge uses user_id ?? sub; Firenook follows the recording
uidDerivation.settled: uid is the user_id claim only; a sub-only token has uid == null (auth-shapes/sub-only-uid-is-null)

adminOnlyRoutes.policy: measured in G1; the official emulator evaluates no rules for download-token creation/deletion, object copy, or any JSON API route (adminStorageLayer); Firenook follows the recording
adminOnlyRoutes.settled: create_token/delete_token are admin-only with 'Missing admin credentials.'; copy hard-codes owner; every JSON API route bypasses rules (bypass-owner-and-download-tokens, bypass-json-api)

uploadOverExistingObject.policy: the official emulator sends method create with resource set to the existing object; production treats an overwrite as update; production wins for method naming only if G1 production cases show a verdict difference for the consumer-shaped rulesets, otherwise the emulator's create-with-resource model is reproduced and the divergence recorded
uploadOverExistingObject.settled: the emulator's create-with-resource model is adopted: an upload over an existing object is create with resource set, allow update alone never admits it (upload-over-existing); projects.test has no upload path

requestMethod.policy: production defines request.method for every operation; the emulator omits it (Property method is undefined on object)
requestMethod.settled: production wins: Firenook defines request.method (divergence request-method-undefined)

listMatching.policy: the emulator matches list paths as prefix templates; production applies standard match semantics to list
listMatching.settled: production wins: standard matching, recursive wildcards may bind zero segments as an empty path (divergence list-prefix-template-matching)

setRulesFailure.policy: the plan assumed a failed reload keeps the previous ruleset
setRulesFailure.settled: the emulator drops the ruleset and serves 403 'Storage Emulator has no loaded ruleset.' for every v0 request including owner until a valid reload; Firenook reproduces this on setRules and keeps failing at startup for a bad ruleset
